hero.eyebrow: MCC Teaching Library · 人師教材庫
hero.h1: Take what you need. Teach it your way.
hero.lead_en: Everything My Culture Connect has made for the English classroom — graded readers with real human audio, thousands of classroom videos, slide decks, and lesson plans. It is a library, not a syllabus.
hero.lead_zh: 人師教育協會為英語課堂製作的所有教材——分級讀本與真人錄音、數千支課堂影片、簡報與教案。這是一座圖書館，不是課綱。

principles.desc_en: Every page here is free to use, copy, and adapt in your classroom. No login, no fee, no permission needed.
principles.desc_zh: 這裡的每一頁都可以免費使用、複製、改編到你的課堂。不必登入、不必付費、不必徵求同意。

principles.desc_en: We do not prescribe what you teach. Every teacher has their own style and their own topics — browse, take what fits your students, leave the rest.
principles.desc_zh: 我們不規定你教什麼。每位老師有自己的風格與想教的主題——挑你班上用得到的，其餘留著就好。

principles.desc_en: Materials carry English and Chinese side by side, so a foreign teacher and a local teacher can work from the same page.
principles.desc_zh: 教材中英並陳，外籍老師與本國老師可以看著同一頁備課。

groups.blurb_en: Ready to teach from — a full week's plan, a deck to project, a one-to-one conversation lesson.
groups.blurb_zh: 拿了就能上的東西——整週的教案、可投影的簡報、一對一會話課。

cards.desc_en: A full academic year of English lessons by Dom Jones, our Advocacy Chair — one complete plan per week, yours to run as written or to raid for parts.
cards.desc_zh: 本會 Advocacy Chair Dom Jones 編寫的整學年英語課程，一週一份完整教案。照著上，或只取你要的部分，都可以。

cards.desc_en: The bilingual decks Dom presents in Changhua school assemblies — SDG themes, quizzes that reveal their answers, games. Projector-ready, plus reusable templates.
cards.desc_zh: Dom 在彰化校園集會實際使用的雙語簡報——SDG 主題、點一下公布答案的題目、課堂遊戲。可直接投影，另附通用範本。

cards.desc_en: Thirteen conversation lessons built around things students actually want to talk about — night markets, bubble tea, festivals, hometowns, movies.
cards.desc_zh: 十三堂以學生真正想聊的主題設計的會話課——夜市、珍奶、節慶、家鄉、電影。

groups.blurb_en: Thirty-nine booklets across six series, from first words to full articles. Every unit carries a human recording, a Chinese translation, vocabulary notes, and a printable PDF.
groups.blurb_zh: 六個系列共三十九本，從第一個字讀到整篇文章。每個單元都有真人錄音、中文翻譯、生字註解與可列印的 PDF。

cards.desc_en: The most basic everyday topics — school, family, food, weather. Where a beginner starts.
cards.desc_zh: 最基礎的日常英語主題——學校、家庭、食物、天氣。初學者從這裡開始。

cards.desc_en: Our largest series: short passages with vocabulary, questions, and full teaching audio. For readers just getting started.
cards.desc_zh: 最大的一個系列：短文搭配生字、問題與完整教學音檔。適合剛起步的讀者。

cards.desc_en: Longer passages that widen vocabulary and sentence patterns, with a Chinese translation beside every paragraph.
cards.desc_zh: 進一步擴充字彙與句型的長篇文章，每段都附中文翻譯。

cards.desc_en: Full-length articles for students ready to be challenged — the last step before reading in the wild.
cards.desc_zh: 給準備好接受挑戰的學生的完整文章——真正自由閱讀前的最後一階。

cards.desc_en: Everyday dialogues for real situations, recorded line by line so students can shadow a native speaker.
cards.desc_zh: 真實情境的日常對話，逐句錄音，學生可以跟著母語者複誦。

cards.desc_en: Look at the picture, say what you see. Builds the speaking and writing muscle that exams and real life both ask for.
cards.desc_zh: 看著圖，把看到的說出來。練的是考試與真實生活都需要的口說與寫作肌肉。

groups.blurb_en: Over two and a half thousand short videos, almost all filmed in real classrooms with real students and teachers.
groups.blurb_zh: 兩千五百支以上的短片，幾乎全在真實教室、與真實的師生一起拍攝。

cards.desc_en: Our largest collection: one English word a day, filmed in a real classroom by a real teacher. Browse by school, by theme, or A–Z — every word comes with two example sentences in English and Chinese.
cards.desc_zh: 最大的一套收藏：每天一個英文單字，由真實的老師在真實的教室拍攝。可依學校、主題或字母瀏覽，每個字都附兩句中英例句。

cards.desc_en: One useful point of English, explained in about a minute. The longest-running series we have.
cards.desc_zh: 一個實用的英語重點，一分鐘講完。我們做得最久的一個系列。

cards.desc_en: Speaking practice for Taiwan's GEPT Elementary test — read-aloud, answering questions, picture description.
cards.desc_zh: 全民英檢初級口說練習——朗讀、回答問題、看圖敘述。

cards.desc_en: The same drill at intermediate level, for students sitting the next tier of the GEPT.
cards.desc_zh: 同樣的練習升到中級，給要考下一階的學生。

cards.desc_en: How an English sentence is built, taken apart one pattern at a time.
cards.desc_zh: 一次拆解一個句型，看懂英文句子是怎麼組成的。

cards.desc_en: Current events as a way into the language — vocabulary students meet outside the textbook.
cards.desc_zh: 用時事帶語言——學生在課本以外會遇到的字彙。

cards.desc_en: From a word to a sentence — the step beginners most often get stuck on.
cards.desc_zh: 從一個字到一個句子——初學者最常卡住的那一步。

cards.desc_en: Assorted short lessons that fit in the last five minutes of a class.
cards.desc_zh: 各式各樣的短片，剛好塞得進下課前最後五分鐘。

cards.desc_en: A minute of English filmed in the United States — language with a place attached to it.
cards.desc_zh: 在美國拍攝的一分鐘英語——把語言連上一個真實的地方。

cards.desc_en: The expressions textbooks leave out but students hear everywhere.
cards.desc_zh: 課本不教、學生卻到處聽得到的說法。

cards.desc_en: English for the school day itself — the campus as the classroom.
cards.desc_zh: 校園生活本身就是教材——把學校當教室的英語。

cards.desc_en: Letters and the sounds they make — the foundation everything else stands on.
cards.desc_zh: 字母與它們的聲音——其他一切的地基。

cards.zh: 彰化 E 視界英語教室
cards.desc_en: Classroom English produced with Changhua's education television programme.
cards.desc_zh: 與彰化教育電視節目合作製作的課堂英語。

groups.title_zh: 用英語認識台灣與彰化
groups.blurb_en: Where your students live, written in English so they can tell a visitor about it. Good for culture lessons, for presentations, and for the day a foreign guest asks "so what is this town like?"
groups.blurb_zh: 把學生生活的地方寫成英文，讓他們能親口介紹給外國人。適合文化課、上台報告，以及外國客人問「這個鄉鎮是什麼樣子」的那一天。

cards.desc_en: Every county and city in Taiwan, introduced in English with Chinese alongside — geography, food, festivals, what makes each one itself.
cards.desc_zh: 台灣每一個縣市的英文介紹，中文並陳——地理、食物、節慶，以及讓每個地方成為自己的東西。

cards.desc_en: The same again, closer to home: all twenty-six townships of Changhua County, for the students who live in them.
cards.desc_zh: 同樣的東西，但離家更近：彰化縣二十六個鄉鎮，寫給住在裡面的學生。

groups.blurb_en: Longer-form material for the classes that want to go deeper.
groups.blurb_zh: 給想走得更深的班級的長篇教材。

cards.desc_en: Orwell's novella read chapter by chapter, with vocabulary, questions, and Chinese notes — a whole term's reading course.
cards.desc_zh: 逐章導讀歐威爾的《動物農莊》，附生字、問題與中文註解——一整學期的閱讀課。

cards.desc_en: The grammar points Taiwanese students get wrong most often, explained in both languages.
cards.desc_zh: 台灣學生最常錯的文法點，用中英兩種語言解釋。

cards.desc_en: Taking long English sentences apart until they stop being frightening.
cards.desc_zh: 把長句一層層拆開，拆到它不再嚇人為止。

cards.desc_en: Thirty short chapters of life wisdom by Leon La Couvée, in English with Chinese beside it — gentle reading, and a good source of discussion questions.
cards.desc_zh: Leon La Couvée 的三十章人生智慧，中英對照——溫和的讀物，也是很好的討論題材來源。

cards.desc_en: Back issues of the English periodicals we have published over the years, scanned page by page.
cards.desc_zh: 協會多年來出版的英語刊物，逐頁掃描典藏。

groups.blurb_en: If you are here on a practicum or volunteering with MCC, start with these.
groups.blurb_zh: 如果你正在人師實習或擔任志工，從這幾份開始。

cards.desc_en: What the practicum involves, what a teaching demo looks like, and what we ask of you while you are with us.
cards.desc_zh: 實習包含什麼、教學演示長什麼樣子，以及你在人師期間我們的期待。

cards.desc_en: How to share a classroom with a Taiwanese homeroom teacher so that both of you are actually teaching.
cards.desc_zh: 如何與台灣導師共用一間教室，讓兩個人都真的在教學。

cards.desc_en: For volunteers taking one-to-one sessions: how a session runs, and what to do when a student goes quiet.
cards.desc_zh: 給帶一對一課程的志工：一堂課怎麼進行，以及學生沉默時該怎麼辦。
